newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, underpinned by firm gilts.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, underpinned by firm gilts.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened slightly lower on Thursday with losses capped by support from firm UK gilts, but traders said shares looked vulnerable to profit-taking after a strong pre-budget rally.
Activity was thin and shares were seen drifting in the absence of support from the U.S. which has a Thanksgiving Day holiday today.

"With Wall Street shut I don't expect us to do much today," said one dealer. "The Dow has been one of the main crutches of our support recently and after the run-up to the Budget the profit-taking will probably continue today."
